To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of agent-oriented software patterns can be an effective way to reduce the development time and costs in the field of robotic applications; (2) the use of software patterns is a way to improve the quality of the software, by providing a set of solutions that have already been proved to work and that are reusable; and (3) software patterns can be used to communicate the knowledge about the domain and the solutions to a problem, and they provide a common language for the developers.

(i) design patterns can help to improve the development of robotic applications, (ii) design patterns can be automatically transformed into source code, (iii) design patterns are reusable and can help to reduce the development effort.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and the evaluation of a methodology to build agent-based robotic systems by using a set of patterns.
providing a methodology for rapid and affordable development of robot applications by means of the reuse of design patterns.
the development of agent-oriented design patterns that can be used to build multi-agent robotic applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed patterns are a good mean to increase the productivity of robotic applications development.
this work is a first step in the right direction for a new way of developing robotic systems.
the use of patterns in the development of multi-agent robotic systems can be very useful to increase the final quality of the system, to reduce development time and to increase reusability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
of a pattern-based approach for rapid and affordable development of robotic applications.
the proposed set-up represents a novel approach to build robot applications in a rapid and affordable way.
the use of patterns for the development of agent-based robotic systems can be an interesting and effective way to reduce the effort needed to develop robotic systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed patterns can be reused as a whole or in part to build a robotic system, thus saving a lot of development effort and time.
design patterns are a very effective mean to increase the reusability and the quality of robotic systems.
the proposed patterns allow to build robotic applications faster and more affordably.
